items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: He says, 'I’ve had everybody in my bands,' and he starts listing all these trumpet players: Harry James, Cootie Williams, on and on.

ctx.x: Major Holley. Okay. So then he doesn’t say anything to me. We jam for 45 minutes. He comes up to me and he says, “I love your playing, can you leave tomorrow for the road?” Now I knew he had a trumpet player. I think it was Jack Sheldon. And I wanted to be polite, I didn’t want to take someone’s gig, so I said to Benny, “I thought you had a trumpet player.” He said, “I didn’t ask you that, can you leave tomorrow for the road?” So I leave, so I get to the gig and we’re ready to go on. And I say to Connie, “Are…
Wow. That is not the typical Benny story.
